sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: The recorded line ends 44.Qa8+ Ke7 45.Qb7+ Kf8 46.Qb8+. The arena observed a White-POV cross-node change from 0.00 to +6.80 and the best known CDB alternative was 45...Kd6. This is a counterintuitive endgame teaching candidate; DCC coverage for this position was partial.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 60M nodes, depth 44, candidate comparison): Kd6 0.00, played Kf8 −8.91 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 8.91 pawns.
